decision_basis: Stage11434 showed scorer reported accuracy can be misleading when a scorer covers only a subset of rows.
The bounded-choice evaluator previously reported constrained_choice_top1_accuracy over scored rows only.
The patched evaluator preserves the legacy scored-row metric but adds coverage-corrected metrics over all rows.
No scorer source is promoted by this patch; it only hardens future evaluation reporting.
next_recommended_step: Do not run another generic support probe; build/train a full-coverage semantic candidate scorer objective or repair admitted residual data geometry first.
stage11434_decision_basis: encoder_option_retrieval_evidence_ledger_head reported high reserved accuracy because it scored only one reserved row.
A deployable scorer must cover all validation, strict, and reserved rows while preserving canary scores and improving reserved residuals.
The next useful implementation is a real semantic scorer objective/head with full row coverage, not inference-side scorer routing.
